case.pattern_description: A single device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) was used on 28 different cards between 2016-11-14 and 2016-12-04. It was recorded as new to every account it touched and sat behind an anonymising proxy on every transaction, which is not how a genuinely shared device behaves -- a household or office device shows returning users. The purchases are small and spread thinly across many cards, so no single cardholder looks alarming; the pattern is only visible as a shared-device cluster across the portfolio.

case.summary: The card’s recent online purchases all originate from a shared anonymised device that has been linked to multiple confirmed fraud cases. Low model risk scores are overridden by the strong ring‑membership signal and the cardholder’s denial, which together place the fraud probability in the high range. Policy guidance mandates opening a case, filing a SAR, and placing all cards on this device under monitoring.

sar.reason: R6/3a: activity connects to a device profile shared with 28 cards across more than one card
sar.narrative: The customer identified as C13487 used the payment card designated C13487‑K1. Between 2016‑11‑15 20:30:00 and 2016‑11‑26 17:39:00 the card generated three online transactions (IDs 3460634, 3478561, 3489320) for a combined total of $439.61. All three transactions occurred within the stated period, with the first at 20:30 on 15 November 2016 and the last at 17:39 on 26 November 2016. The activity was conducted through the online channel using product code C on a Samsung SM‑G935F device running Android 7.0, Chrome 62.0 for Android, with a screen resolution of 1920×1080. The pattern of the three purchases is undocumented and each transaction was anonymised, yet all three were executed from the same device profile. The device profile is shared with 28 other cards, is newly associated with every account, and is linked to a set of connected cards including C01289‑K1, C01996‑K2, C02910‑K1, C02975‑K1, C03676‑K2, C04108‑K2, C04274‑K1, C05448‑K2, C06031‑K2, C06650‑K2, C06710‑K1, and C07472‑K1. When contacted, the cardholder affirmed that they did not make the purchases and confirmed that they still possess the card. The combination of an undocumented transaction pattern, a device profile shared across multiple unrelated accounts, and the cardholder’s denial renders the activity suspicious.
